model_annotation: Figure 5 illustrates the training dynamics of LUFFY compared with on-policy RL, plotting three metrics over training steps: outcome training rewards (left), generation length (middle), and generation entropy (right). The x-axis in all three subplots is labeled “Steps” and spans from 0 to approximately 500, with tick marks at intervals of 100. The left subplot’s y-axis, “Outcome Training Rewards,” ranges from 0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals; the red “On-policy RL” line starts near 0.8, dips slightly, then rises to ~0.95, while the blue “LUFFY” line begins near 0.6, rises steadily to ~0.9, and the yellow “Off-policy Reasoning Traces” line remains near 0.6 throughout. The middle subplot’s y-axis, “Response Length,” ranges from 0 to 20, with tick marks at 5-unit intervals; the red “On-policy RL” line starts near 10, rises to ~18, then fluctuates; the blue “LUFFY” line starts near 5, rises to ~15, and stabilizes; the yellow “Off-policy Reasoning Traces” line remains flat near 5. The right subplot’s y-axis, “Entropy,” ranges from 0 to 4, with tick marks at 1-unit intervals; the red “On-policy RL” line starts near 3.5, drops sharply to ~1.5, then rises slightly; the blue “LUFFY” line starts near 3.0, drops to ~1.0, then rises to ~2.0; the yellow “Off-policy Reasoning Traces” line remains near 1.0. A vertical dashed line labeled “Continuous Exploration” appears in the right subplot around step 200. Figure 4, referenced in the text, plots training rewards for LLaMA-3.1-8B on Easy and Hard training sets, with “Steps” on the x-axis (0 to 500) and “Training Rewards” on the y-axis (−2.0 to 0.0), showing LUFFY outperforming on-policy RL on the Hard set.
